svg.text: The large-D forms the f64 points allowed, and the one the double-double points leave
Every curve reproduces the f64 Δ for D = 4–40 to its precision; they agree to 1e-5 up to D ≈ 60 and fan out above D ≈ 100 toward different limits.
The double-double points up to D = 61 decide it: fitted to them, half-integer series predict unseen points 40–300× worse than the 1/D series and forced limits 100–3500× worse (README).
The analytic family (blue) is the one left, with Δ∞ = 1.643893746; the faded curves are ruled out.
